title: Organize Pages
description: Reorder, rotate, delete, duplicate and insert pages from several PDFs and images, then save one PDF.

title: Merge
description: Combine PDFs and images into one PDF, in the order you choose.

title: Split
description: Split a PDF into single pages, every N pages or custom ranges.

title: Extract Pages
description: Save chosen pages as a new PDF.

title: Remove Pages
description: Save a copy without the pages you choose.

title: Rotate
description: Turn pages by 90°, 180° or 270°.

title: Images to PDF
description: Turn photos, screenshots and scans into a PDF.

title: Scan with iPhone
description: Use your iPhone’s camera to scan paper drawings straight into a PDF (Continuity Camera).

title: Office to PDF
description: Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint and OpenDocument files to PDF.

title: PDF to Images
description: Save pages as PNG, JPEG or TIFF images.

title: PDF to Word
description: Create an editable Word document (.docx).

title: PDF to Excel
description: Pull tables — BOMs, title blocks, schedules — into Excel (.xlsx).

title: PDF to PowerPoint
description: One slide per page, with the filename as an editable title.

title: PDF to Text
description: Extract all text as plain text or Markdown.

title: Extract Images
description: Save the pictures embedded in a PDF.

title: Compress
description: Make PDFs smaller for email. Drawings stay sharp.

title: Make Searchable (OCR)
description: Recognise text in scans so you can search and copy it.

title: Repair
description: Rebuild damaged PDFs that will not open properly.

title: Flatten
description: Burn comments, markups and form fields into the page.

title: Page Numbers
description: Number pages in a corner of your choice.

title: Watermark & Stamp
description: Add DRAFT, APPROVED, SUPERSEDED… or your own text or logo.

title: Crop
description: Trim white margins automatically, or cut fixed margins.

title: Resize to Sheet
description: Scale pages onto a standard sheet such as A3 or Letter. Lines stay vector.

title: Tile for Printing
description: Print a large sheet on A4/A3 paper as overlapping tiles with cut marks.

title: Pages per Sheet
description: Put 2, 4, 6, 9 or 16 pages on one sheet for overviews.

title: Overlay PDF
description: Stamp another PDF — e.g. a title block or approval stamp — onto every page.

title: Edit Metadata
description: Change document metadata, or remove defined auxiliary data. Page content still needs review.

title: Mark Up
description: Draw, highlight, add callouts and text with MARK, then save as PDF.

title: Protect
description: Encrypt with a password (AES-256) and limit printing, copying or editing.

title: Unlock
description: Remove the password from a PDF you are allowed to open.

title: Redact
description: Remove matching searchable page text. Review images, metadata, annotations and attachments separately.

title: Compare Drawings
description: Overlay two revisions: removed lines in red, added in blue, changed areas boxed, plus text changes.
